caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic vessel shaped to resemble a human head and upper torso. The vessel is a neutral brown-gray color and features a smooth, rounded base that tapers into a sculpted human-like face. The face has two eyes with defined eyelids, a broad nose with two nostrils, and a full-lipped mouth. Both ears are represented in relief on the sides, with hoops or rings drawn as dashed lines around them. At the top, the vessel forms an opening with a spouted neck and, adjacent to it, a looped handle. The composition is centered within a rectangular border on a cream-colored background, and the artist’s name, Annie B. Johnston, is written in the lower right corner.
title: Stoneware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
